stem: Events A and B have P(A) = 0.3, P(B) = 0.2, and P(A and B) = 0.01. What is P(A or B)?
why: P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) - P(A and B) = 0.3 + 0.2 - 0.01 = 0.49. Adding without subtracting the overlap gives 0.50; 0.06 is the product P(A)P(B).
